note: A working draft from the categories named in the concept note. Replace it with Equity Bank's ARCAFIM adaptation taxonomy when it is shared, and raise the version: loans tagged under an older version are tagged again. Keywords are phrases, chosen so ordinary words (processing fee, cooler box, warehouse rent) do not match; the keyword classifier is the fallback, and every tag is reviewed.

categories.label: Irrigation and water
categories.description: Irrigation equipment, water pumps, drip kits, boreholes, wells, water tanks and water harvesting for farming or livestock.

categories.label: Post-harvest storage
categories.description: Grain stores, hermetic bags, silos, cold rooms and drying equipment that reduce post-harvest loss.

categories.label: Renewable energy
categories.description: Solar pumps, solar dryers and panels, biogas and clean cooking used in farming or a rural enterprise.

categories.label: Agro-processing
categories.description: Milling, processing, value addition and packaging of farm produce.

categories.label: Climate-smart inputs and practices
categories.description: Drought-tolerant seed, greenhouses, shade nets, conservation agriculture, agroforestry and resilient livestock breeds.

notAdaptation.label: Not climate adaptation
notAdaptation.description: School fees, consumption, medical bills, household goods, debt consolidation and business stock with no adaptation purpose.
